final: WITH channel_stats AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.orderbase), total AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count FROM channel_stats) SELECT s.orderbase, s.avg_fillcount, s.order_count, 1.0 * s.order_count / t.total_count FROM channel_stats AS s JOIN total AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL
